tracks.title: What I Didn’t Have to Earn
tracks.description: Outro — what stayed without my having to deserve it.
tracks.prompt: Contemporary organic-electronic, AwakeSoul. Warm female vocals with poetic lyrics. Soft synth pads, piano, subtle percussion, strings. Intimate, contemplative, transformative. No autotune. Clean vocal production. 70 BPM, signature element: intimate whisper close-mic, no afrobeats no afropop no amapiano no tropical. Lyrics in English. Sacred but not religious, body-centred, breath as prayer. intimate, contemplative, vulnerable. intimate whisper close-mic. Theme: Outro — what stayed without my having to deserve it..
tracks.lyrics:
[Vocal: ONE warm mezzo-contralto female voice, intimate speaking quality, slight breathiness on sustained notes, sings very close to the microphone, layered airy harmonies emerging only on choruses (3 voices max — root, third, fifth), no melisma, no belting, no riffs, no autotune]
[CRITICAL: subtle international English accent, NOT American, NOT exaggerated British]
[Persona: Loranne — contemporary organic-electronic, AwakeSoul lineage, contemplative and transformative]

[Intro: solo felt-piano, warm Wurlitzer pad, room tone, breath audible, no drums]
[Verse 1]
I made a small list this evening
Of what I did not have to earn
The cup of tea that was already warm
The chair that fit
The way the kitchen still smells of bread
The fact that the body wakes up
And carries me from one room to the next
Without sending me a bill
[Verse 2]
None of this is mine
And all of this is mine
This is the small contradiction
That makes living possible
What was given to me freely
I could not have asked for
What was given to me freely
Is the floor I stand on
[Pre-Chorus]

The bill never came
The bill is not coming
Stop checking the door
Stop preparing for it
[Chorus]
What I did not have to earn
Is more than what I earned
What I did not have to earn
Is the larger half of my life
Don't make me a saint for noticing
I am only the woman
Who kept her eyes open

[Verse 3]
If there is a thing called grace
And there may not be
This is the closest I have come
To meeting it
The small Tuesday afternoon
With the warm tea
And the chair that fits
And the bread still in the kitchen
[Chorus]
What I did not have to earn
Is more than what I earned
What I did not have to earn
Is the larger half of my life

[Bridge: vocal close, single soft harmony layer enters, only piano — opens, does not resolve]
There is a tally I no longer keep
Of debts and payments
There is a different tally I keep now
Of small graces, small arrivals
Small mercies, small returns
And the tally is long
And the tally is long
[Outro: vocal exhaled, piano resolves softly to C major in last bar]
What I did not have to earn
the larger half
the larger half
of my life
